existing_issues.issue: Opus number: IMSLP (page 'Violin Sonata No.2, Op.94bis'; first edition Muzgiz 1945, plate 18214; Oistrakh ed. International Music 1958) uses Op. 94bis, the usual scholarly form for the violin version of the Flute Sonata Op. 94. Wikipedia prints 'Op. 94a' as primary but notes it is 'sometimes written Op. 94bis'. Prefer IMSLP/publishers.
existing_issues.suggested_title: Sonata No. 2 in D major, Op. 94bis

existing_issues.issue: Opus attribution is unconfirmed: a model pass suggested 'Op. 75 No. 5', but Carl Fischer's Heifetz edition (B2616, Jascha Heifetz Series) is titled 'Masks' from the ballet Romeo and Juliet, and recordings credit it under Op. 64; the piano piece 'Masques' is Op. 75 No. 5 but I found nothing saying Heifetz worked from it. Safer to cite the ballet, Op. 64.
existing_issues.suggested_title: Masks from Romeo and Juliet, Op. 64 (arr. Heifetz)

existing_issues.issue: Vague title. The published violin-and-piano set is Sikorski SIK 2419 '3 Pieces from Romeo and Juliet' (arr. D. Grünes / 'Grjunes'): Die Montagues und Capulets (Montagues and Capulets), Tanz der jungen Mädchen (Dance of the Young Girls), Maskentanz (Masks dance). Could be split into three pieces if English titles are confirmed from the score.
existing_issues.suggested_title: Romeo and Juliet: 3 Pieces, Op. 64 (arr. Grünes)
